purpose: This table holds hourly surface weather observations (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, and visibility) for the three New York City area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, joined with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway).
usage: Consumers should read the table at its airport_code, observed_hour_utc grain: one row per airport per UTC hour. Expect wind_gust_mph to be populated only about 25% of the time and pressure_mb and wind_dir_degrees to carry smaller but nonzero null rates; treat nulls in those columns as 'not recorded' rather than zero.
limitations: The profile cannot fully confirm the grain beyond row-count and duplicate-row-rate evidence; the airport_code/observed_hour_utc pairing is the most defensible candidate but remains unverified until measured against the warehouse. wind_gust_mph is missing for roughly 75% of rows and pressure_mb for roughly 11%. The captured_at column is not flagged as pipeline metadata in the profile, but its three near-identical timestamps suggest it is an ingestion load timestamp rather than business data; it is retained as profiled pending reviewer confirmation.
